rationale.complete: Round 1, synthetic validation and the #45 holdout run are done; round 1b re-ran everything on the corrected minute grid with DQ8 nulls and added three period-native tests (#12 teams, the #44 leader, NE14) plus a synthetic check of what the bug did to the holdout rule. Open: message-level influence (H02-R1/R2), the #14/#49 transfer set, a decision on re-running #45.
rationale.faithfulness: The core claim (pairwise activity couplings measure influence) is refuted on the holdout and on every corrected analog (#12, #44b, #26). The collective coupling that partly survived round 1 is mostly day edges once nulls are trimmed; only weak regime-I co-activation and a post-hoc talk-spin signal remain.
rationale.usefulness: A clean, well-controlled negative with a concrete warning (trim day edges before any synchrony statistic; do not read leaders from activity timing) and one lead (talk-spin couplings), consistent with H50.

one_line: Activity-timing couplings stay null on corrected data; the regime-III collective coupling was day edges
